description: NUREG-1150, Severe Accident Risks: An Assessment for Five U.S. Nuclear Power Plants, is a staff publication of the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission that assesses the risk of severe reactor accidents at five American plants. The NRC page lists the report as three files: Volume 1, the final summary report, and Volumes 2 and 3, which hold Appendices A, B and C and Appendices D and E of the final report. It was last reviewed on 14 September 2026. The volumes are free to download as PDF files from the NRC website; no registration is needed and the page states no licence. Coverage is five named-in-report US plants, not the whole fleet, and the assessment is a risk study, not an observed event. Caveats: only the landing page was read for this record, so the plant names, the method and the numerical results are not summarised here and should be taken from the volumes; the report dates from the era of its first publication and later studies revised parts of it. It suits risk and vulnerability assessment studies of nuclear plants, and relates to the NRC SOARCA state-of-the-art reactor consequence analyses catalogued here.
